author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: 1.9.4 - device icons (1.9.3) now also check the device's own name before falling back to capability, for the many virtual switches/plugs whose capability alone can't say what they are - a device named Tuya Kettle, Festoon Lights, Internet Down or Gas Heater now reads as an appliance, a light, network/internet, or climate instead of a plain switch. Three more categories - Notification gateway (auto-detected), Hub & infrastructure, and AI node (both manual-only, no reliable capability or name signal exists yet) - are also selectable in the Device icons panel. And the icons themselves are far easier to actually see on the map: each one now sits on a solid coloured circle instead of a bare glyph on the dark background, which was hard to spot without zooming in.
